sections.heading: Bug Fixes
lines: Fixed an issue where some machines connected to the Star Spiral space station showed insufficient power input after having infinite threads and parallelism

sections.heading: Mechanic Changes
lines: Enhanced customization options for Personal Dimensions
Changed the Super Pattern Bus mechanism for inputs exceeding the long limit; inputs are now processed in batches
Added more information for machines with insufficient output space
Time in a Bottle now maintains continuous acceleration on click until clicked again
Pattern Management Terminal now hides empty slots
You can now press 'A' directly in quest details to bookmark items
Cross-recipe-type parallel machines can now be accelerated with Time in a Bottle

sections.heading: Notice
lines: Due to logic changes in the Infinite Power Grid Input Terminal, older saves may require breaking and replacing the block
